agent_note: First-person past-tense retrospective narration (a cop in NYC), with a third-person past strand (Christoph). Heavy aphorism load -- 7 of 23 quotes are gnomic, the expected Goodreads quotability bias -- but every specific-moment quote but one is past. Quotation marks survive in this book, so the mark-majority test carried the dialogue calls; q05165 is the one unmarked-speech call, made on direct address.
